page_title: GEN 0-1 ACM | Genoa v AC Milan 07/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+15' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+14' Here is a change. Koni De Winter is going off and Alberto Gilardino gives the last tactical orders to Nicola Leali (Genoa).
90+13' Josep Martinez (Genoa) is getting some glares from his teammates as the referee pulls out a second yellow card and sends him off for an early bath.
90+12' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
90+12' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) fires the ball from the free kick and it smashes against the crossbar!
90+11' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+9' It‘s a RED card, and quite right too after seeing the replay! Referee Marco Piccinini had no choice but to send Mike Maignan (AC Milan) off. VAR seen to good effect there!

90+8' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Mike Maignan (AC Milan), but referee Marco Piccinini must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
90+6' Mike Maignan (AC Milan) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+6' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+3' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Davide Bartesaghi (AC Milan) replaces Luka Jovic.
90+1' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ridgeciano Haps departs the field of play to be replaced by George Puscas (Genoa).
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
90' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Marco Piccinini to decide it wasn’t handball. The relieved AC Milan players can finally celebrate.
90' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible handball. The AC Milan players aren’t happy.

87' 0 - 1 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) meets a perfect cross from Yunus Musah on the edge of the penalty area and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike straight into the bottom right corner. It's 0:1.
86' Josep Martinez (Genoa) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
85' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) tries to find Christian Pulisic, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
83' Davide Calabria (AC Milan) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
81' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
80' Marco Piccinini blows for a foul after Johan Vasquez (Genoa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
79' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
78' Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
77' A cross from a corner kick by Genoa is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
76' Radu Dragusin (Genoa) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
74' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
73' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
69' Koni De Winter (Genoa) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Piccinini had an easy-decision to make.
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Stefano Sabelli as he is replaced by Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
68' It will be a substitution. Berkan Kutlu (Genoa) is ready to enter the pitch as Ruslan Malinovsky walks off.
66' AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
66' Stefano Pioli prepares a substitution. Alessandro Florenzi is replaced by Davide Calabria (AC Milan).
66' Substitution. Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) has come on for Yacine Adli.
65' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the roof of the net, but Josep Martinez is prepared and leaps to thwart him.
62' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
62' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
58' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) fires a volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the ball goes well wide of the left post.
57' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
56' The ball is cleared after Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

53' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Albert Gudmundsson was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
50' The AC Milan players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
47' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) has tested the patience of referee Marco Piccinini and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christian Pulisic replaces Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) is replaced by Rafael Leao.
46' The whistle blows and Marco Piccinini starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' Noah Okafor (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
41' AC Milan fail to score from a corner as Josep Martinez (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball.
38' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
34' Ruslan Malinovsky (Genoa) brings his opponent down. Marco Piccinini has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
29' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
28' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
26' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
24' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
22' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
21' Marco Piccinini shows a yellow card to Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.

18' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a short pass inside a congested penalty area and takes a first-time shot. The effort heads towards the middle of the goal but Josep Martinez blocks the shot with his legs.
16' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) hits a shot towards the top of the net from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Josep Martinez.
16' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
12' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
11' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
11' Marco Piccinini interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
9' One of the Genoa players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
6' AC Milan seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) swings it in and Noah Okafor gets on the end of it, but Josep Martinez shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.
2' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
AC Milan will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Marco Piccinini.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
